newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Menem administration mostly bad or very bad - poll.
newsitem.headline: Menem administration mostly bad or very bad - poll.

text.p: Fifty-nine percent of Buenos Aires and Greater Buenos Aires population thinks Argentine Peronist President Carlos Menem administration is bad or very bad, according to a private survey published Sunday.
A 28 percent of those asked said the administration was regular and only 12 percent consider it postive, pollster Graciela Romer y Asociados said according La Nacion newspaper.
Only 16 percent considered the economic administration to be good or very good while the rest saw it as regular or bad.
Sixty percent said the main Argentine problem was unemployment --currently at 16.1 percent--, 12 percent said it was corruption and six percent said it was education.
The poll was conducted in the first week of July among 805 inhabitants of Buenos Aires and Greater Buenos Aires aged over 18 years, and it has a trustability of 95 percent.
